issues.description: Attribute 'user_name': the problem statement (problem_statement.md line 22) requires defining user_name as a string buffer. The template (template_repository/helloWorld.asm lines 2-4) does not declare user_name at all in the .data section. The solution (solution_repository/helloWorld.asm line 4) declares user_name as an integer using 'user_name dd 0' (doubleword). This mismatch about the name, type and storage size of user_name will confuse students about the expected data layout and how to use the symbol (string buffer vs 32-bit integer).
issues.suggestedFix:
Make the declaration of user_name consistent with the problem statement by reserving a byte buffer in both template and solution. For example, in .data add a NASM-compatible string buffer:
user_name times 32 db 0    ; reserve a 32-byte string buffer for user_name
Update the solution to use 'db' (byte buffer) instead of 'dd' so both template and solution match the specification. Adjust the buffer size if a different capacity is intended and update any code that uses user_name accordingly.
